topic: reading a first error: type, message, line number
prompt_markdown: This script stops with an error when a visitor types `south-02`.
On which line does it fail, and what kind of error is it?
hint: Check every name on each line: was it given a value earlier?

error_types.text: NameError: a name Python does not know
SyntaxError: the code is not written correctly
TypeError: an operation on the wrong kind of value
